import { JournalEntry } from '../domain/journal-entry.js';
import type { PostEntryCommand } from '../contracts/index.js';
import type { AuditPort } from '../../../audit/src/contracts/index.js';

export const postEntry = async (cmd: PostEntryCommand, audit: AuditPort): Promise<JournalEntry> => {
  const entry = new JournalEntry({ amount: cmd.amount, currency: cmd.currency }, { amount: cmd.amount, currency: cmd.currency });
  await audit.append({ workspaceId: 'w', action: 'ledger.journal_entry.posted' });
  return entry;
};
